title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1971-02-23

ai_review.summary: Audience recording captures a strong show highlighted by a jaw‑dropping "The Other One", but muddy sound makes the listening experience difficult.
ai_review.review: The performance itself gets high marks – reviewers rave about an incredible rendition of "The Other One" and consider the concert a great show. However, the AUD source suffers from poor fidelity and imbalance that many listeners find hard to sit through, limiting overall enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised (especially The Other One) while recording quality is criticized as muddy; weighted combination yields a mid‑range rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound is muddy and uneven, making the show hard to get through; some moments are audible but overall fidelity is low.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set pacing; reviewers focus on individual song quality.
